---
title: "تلوار کہہ رہی ہے کسی روزہ دار سے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Talwar keh rahi hay kisi roza daar se
Sar ko bachaiye sitam e bad shoaar se

1
Jis ka khayal tha waheen talwar parr gayi
Jis may Imam surkh hua khoon ki dhaar se

2
Zalim ki tegh nay kia bagh-e-Nabi tabah
Doar e khizan lipat gaya barrh kar bahar se

3
Farq e Imam e Paak tha Quran se bhi siwa
Eeman kat gaya bin e Muljim(la) ke waar se

4
Dekha jo betiyon ne pidar ko lahoo may gharq
Ansoo tapak parray nigah-e-intezar se

5
Gul ho gaya charagh e Imamat qareeb e subh
Dunya siyah ho gayi zaalim ke waar se

6
Asaar e marg dekhay jo Zainab ne Shah par
Dil ki ragain ulajh gayeen ashkon ke taar se

7
Zikr e Ali se Fazl hay jannat teray liye
Mayoos kyon hay rehmat e Parwardigar se

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/tloar-khh-rahi-hai-ksi-rozh-dar-se.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '1234567'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵۶۷')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert len(blocks) == 8 and len(blocks[0]) == 2
    assert all(len(block) == 3 and block[0].strip() == number for block, number in zip(blocks[1:], numbers))
print('Both editions contain an opening couplet and seven numbered couplets.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script edition in [the selected lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/186569e79fa54dcca9a60465840d0cea/src/data/lyrics/tloar-khh-rahi-hai-ksi-rozh-dar-se.md) and moved the Roman verses into `romanLyrics`. Both editions contain the opening couplet and seven numbered couplets. Set the direction to right-to-left and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Doar e khizan” as `دورِ خزاں` and kept the annotation after Muljim in the Urdu body as `(لع)`, omitting it from the Roman pronunciation aid.
